description.en: A resizable blank panel with a hidden handle, directional bending, and a short resisted stretch beyond its width limits.
description.zh: 把手靠近时显现，拖动时同向弯曲；超过面板宽度边界后弹性拉伸，松手回弹。

keywords: 弹性 面板 缩放 调整 宽度 拖动 把手 弯曲 回弹 elastic panel resize spring handle drag

discovery.caveat: 将拖拽尺寸接入实际布局，并检查项目需要的最小宽度。

instructions.en: Drag the left edge to resize. Use arrow keys, Home or End when focused; double-click or press Escape to reset.
instructions.zh: 拖动面板左边缘调整宽度。聚焦后可用方向键、Home 或 End；双击或按 Escape 重置。
